hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue is a key indicator of revenue stability and predictability, particularly important in the technology sector due to its high margins and valuation multiples.

kpis.name: Recurring Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from monthly cellular communication services sold.
kpis.description: Recurring revenue increased by 14% in fiscal 2025 compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Gross Margin (Recurring Services)
kpis.explanation: Gross margin generated from recurring services revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin for recurring services was 91.0% in fiscal 2025, up 0.5 point from 90.5% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Exceptionally high gross margin on recurring services.

kpis.name: Gross Margin (Equipment)
kpis.explanation: Gross margin generated from finished product sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin for equipment revenue was 23.6% in fiscal 2025, compared to 29.4% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Decline in gross margin on equipment.

kpis.name: Total Net Revenue
kpis.description: Net revenue decreased by 3.8% in fiscal 2025 compared to 2024, declining from $188.8M to $181.6M.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income decreased by 12.9% in fiscal 2025 compared to 2024, falling from $49.8M to $43.4M.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on the acquisition or improvement of physical assets.
kpis.description: Purchases of property, plant and equipment increased by 32.7% in fiscal 2025 compared to 2024, rising from $1.6M to $2.1M.
